items.quote: Several respondents noted that Serdre Ravari handled upholding governance and audit standards competently within her team.
Direct reports said that Serdre was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of the move of paper-based permit applications to an online portal.
Peers observed that Serdre Ravari took ownership of work with three sister agencies on a shared problem and steered it to completion.
She spearheaded media interviews and press conferences at the national level.
Several respondents noted that Serdre Ravari was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of emergency coordination during the flood response.
Several respondents noted that Serdre Ravari championed customer feedback improvements at service centres and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Direct reports said that Serdre drove steadying the unit after its flagship project was cancelled for the whole division.
